from rdkit import Chem

# Parse the product SMILES
product = "Cc1cn(-c2ccc(Nc3nc4(s3)CCCC4c3ccccc3)cc2Cl)cn1"

    # Print bonds

    for bond in mol.GetBonds():

    print(f"\nNumber of rings: {len(ssrs)}")

        ring_atoms = [mol.GetAtomWithIdx(idx).GetSymbol() for idx in ring]

else:
